input.command:
git add server/src/services/agents.ts server/src/routes/agents.ts tests/cf-smoke/cf-smoke.spec.ts package.json && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(server): resolve agents by URL key + pass agent.id to downstream calls

The :id URL param for agent routes can be either a UUID or a URL key
derived from the agent name (e.g. \"ceo-2\" for \"CEO 2\"). Previously
agentService.getById queried agents.id directly, throwing a Postgres
\"invalid input syntax for type uuid\" on URL keys.

Changes:
- agentService.getById now isUuidLike-checks the input. UUIDs use direct
  lookup; non-UUIDs are resolved by scanning agents and matching
  normalizeAgentUrlKey(name). The route handler enforces company access
  on the resolved agent.

- Fix raw-id-after-resolve bugs in 8 handlers (same pattern as the issue
  routes fix earlier): pass agent.id (resolved UUID) downstream instead
  of the raw param:
    listAgentSkills (n/a — already used agent.id)
    listAgentConfigRevisions      → svc.listConfigRevisions(agent.id)
    getAgentConfigRevision        → svc.getConfigRevision(agent.id, ...)
    rollbackAgentConfigRevision   → svc.rollbackConfigRevision(existing.id, ...)
    getAgentRuntimeState          → heartbeat.getRuntimeState(agent.id)
    listAgentTaskSessions         → heartbeat.listTaskSessions(agent.id)
    resetAgentRuntimeSession      → heartbeat.resetRuntimeSession(agent.id, ...)
                                    + logActivity entityId: agent.id
    wakeupAgent                   → heartbeat.wakeup(agent.id, ...)
                                    + actor.agentId !== agent.id check
    listAgentKeys                 → svc.listKeys(agent.id)
    createAgentKey                → svc.createApiKey(agent.id, ...)

DX: dev:cf now runs `pnpm --filter @paperclipai/server dev:watch`
instead of `dev`, so the Node sidecar reloads on server source changes
(matching the existing esbuild --watch on the worker side). Without this,
shared server/src changes only take effect after a manual restart.

Smoke test: extend agent-scoped suite to hit each route twice — once
with the UUID, once with the URL key — to permanently guard against
this bug class.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
input.description: Commit agent URL key resolution fixes
